items.name: Screen Studio 4.0
items.tagline: Glass Loupe, Camera Cutout, Edit by Transcript, and more
items.description: The screen recorder for Mac that handles the hard parts: zooms, motion, sound, and framing. Every demo and tutorial comes out polished. What's new in 4.0: - Glass Loupe, a zoom that magnifies one detail - Split screen, also for vertical video - Edit your video like you edit text - Camera cutout: you, without your background - Hide sensitive data and faces automatically - Sharper zooms, ProRes, up to 4x faster exports, and more

items.name: ClawsGO Science
items.tagline: The AI research agent with its own cloud lab
items.description: Research, fully automated. ClawsGO Science takes a question to discovery and writes it up as a cited paper. Its cloud lab has 500+ tools and 90+ datasets. Its long-horizon harness runs clusters of Claude and GPT agents for days. The next paradigm for science.

items.name: Riverside Agents
items.tagline: A team of AI agents for video: produce, edit, clip, post
items.description: Riverside Agents is a team of AI agents built only for video. A Producer preps your session, an Editor turns raw recordings into a finished episode, a Clipper cuts the best moments into social clips, and a Marketer writes captions and schedules posts. You choose how much to automate, and nothing is published until you approve it. Included in every Riverside plan, with a 14-day free trial.

items.name: Embage
items.tagline: Build agent for your customers, run workflows, analyzed.
items.description: Build multichannel AI chat and voice agents for your website, Telegram, and beyond. Create specialized sub-agents to orchestrate workflows across your knowledge bases, datastores, and hundreds of third-party tools in real time. Automatically evaluate every interaction, score lead quality, and extract structured data straight from conversation transcripts.

items.name: Precise Edit by Ideogram
items.description: The upgraded Precise Edit supports a context window, so it edits images at any resolution up to 8K at their original pixels and renders small text, logos, and fine detail more sharply.

items.name: agentmash
items.tagline: open-source multiplayer AI for teams' coding agents
items.description: Agentmash is an open-source multiplayer AI for teams' coding agents, a shared context layer that tells every agent which files a teammate's agent is changing, so the agents talk to each other and work on their own without overwriting anyone's code. You can switch between tasks running on different models, @mention a teammate, your own agent or a teammate's agent like in Slack, and keep skills, chats and automations in sync. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or your own open-source models

items.name: Modelpeers
items.tagline: Follow AI models and agents like you follow people
items.description: Modelpeers is like LinkedIn for AI models and agents. Follow Claude Code, GPT-6, Gemini and 200 others, and see their new versions, price and limit changes, outages and retirements in your feed.

items.name: Click
items.tagline: Managed agents API that works with any model
items.description: Managed Agents API you can use with any model. Send a task with an API call, and Click runs the agent and streams back results. Click gives you the entire agent stack over an API, with no infrastructure to manage. Sessions are created with everything your agent needs - a sandbox, browser, and web search. Agents run on a harness with the latest innovations, like deferred tool discovery to support 1000s of tools, and Code Mode to use tools with scripts.

items.name: magpie
items.tagline: everything you’ve saved, in one visual library
items.description: One visual library for everything you save on Instagram, X, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Reddit, Dribbble, Behance, Are.na and the web. Tagged by AI, searchable by meaning and colour, and kept even when the post is gone.

items.name: BeeBranch
items.description: An open-source alternative to commercial Git clients, built for teams working with GitLab and GitHub: no proprietary cloud, no vendor account, no telemetry and no AI.

items.name: Raah.dev
items.tagline: Track your revenue, analytics, and website performance
items.description: Connect payments and conversions with page speed, API latency, errors, and ISP performance in one dashboard. Revenue analytics and real-user observability for humans and AI agents.

items.name: Yuzu Sync
items.tagline: Mirror, copy or two-way sync folders on your Mac
items.description: A small menu-bar app that keeps pairs of folders in sync with a bundled rsync engine. Mirror a project to an SSD, copy photos to a NAS, or sync both ways. Preview changes first, schedule jobs, and remembered disks are matched by UUID so a same-named wrong disk is refused. Every file it replaces or removes is archived for 30 days, never silently deleted. macOS 14+.

items.name: CutCat
items.tagline: Skip or mute marked scenes while you watch Netflix
items.description: A free Chrome extension that skips or mutes scenes other viewers have marked as sex, nudity, gore, or strong language. You choose which. Works on Netflix in Chrome on a computer. Not affiliated with Netflix.

items.name: Termy
items.tagline: Your coding agent, in the notch
items.description: Claude Code and Codex in a terminal that drops down from your MacBook's notch. Live status, approvals from the notch, an office of your agents, a browser for your local server, on-device dictation and checkpoints.

items.name: ernd
items.tagline: The credit card for the AI stack
items.description: ernd is a credit card for companies that pay for AI. Card spend at AI vendors earns 4% back, and we're negotiating big partnerships with AI providers for better pricing, faster inference and dedicated GPUs.

items.name: Usage for Claude + ChatGPT 4.0
items.tagline: Claude + ChatGPT limits on your Mac, iPhone, iPad and Watch
items.description: Version 4 is a big one. Usage for Claude now tracks ChatGPT accounts too, with your Codex session and weekly limits next to Claude's. See every account at once in three styles (Minimal, Detailed, Chart), put several in the Mac menu bar, and keep them on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and widgets. Alerts tell you before you run out, and the history shows where your week went. You sign in on the official Claude and ChatGPT pages, and your data stays in your own iCloud. Free, with Pro extras.

items.name: Chorin: Ora et Labora
items.tagline: Build a real medieval abbey, from 1258 to today
items.description: A calm idle game about Kloster Chorin, a real Cistercian abbey near Berlin. Every monk has a name; the seasons and the night change the work, and every chronicle page cites its sources. Free to start, no ads, eight languages, works offline.

items.name: Hamdori
items.tagline: A tiny 3D hamster that lives on your desktop
items.description: A 3D golden hamster who lives in a corner of your Mac or Windows desktop. He closes his eyes when you pet him, nibbles seeds while you type and naps when you walk away. Focus timer, toys and a file drawer too. No monitoring permissions, one-time purchase.

items.name: Fluent 2
items.tagline: AI teammates that run locally on your Mac
items.description: Introducing AI teammates – saving hours on your routine. They use your apps like you do and keep working while you sleep. Run them on a local model: fully private, no usage limits, and $0 a month. Or pick any cloud model you like.
